title: 第19章 收获颇丰第20章 青鸾界青荻
slug: 穿越修真界开局娶了美女大师姐
lines: 陆飞烟从藤条里钻出来，先在那人身上狠狠踢了几脚，然后拔剑干脆利落地斩下头颅。对这个身后放箭的卑鄙小人，她连审问的兴趣都没有。
莫凡提剑在手，对陆飞烟说：“我在前面探路，你跟在我后面。”说完，向洞穴走去。
陆飞烟用柔和的眼神看着莫凡，然后道：“好吧。”
洞穴大小刚好能够一个人行走，虽然狭窄但并不黑暗，因为洞穴岩壁发出莹莹的白光。
莫凡小心探索，以免误触到什么机关。但一路都很安全，没有任何机关和陷阱。
洞穴蜿蜒，一路向下。走了有一里，来到一个石室。石室不大，只有两丈见方，当中有一张石桌。一道身影背朝洞口，坐在石桌前。
“前辈，打扰了！”莫凡拱手，轻声说道。
久久没有回应，身后的陆飞烟轻声道：“该不会是死了吧。”
莫凡觉得在理，走到那身影的前面。
真的已经死了！宽大的衣袍下，只有一具骸骨。骸骨上还有黑色的斑纹。
“是中毒死的，你看骸骨上的这些黑斑。”凑过来的陆飞烟道。
莫凡还是修真界的小白，看不懂这些。他看向尸骸前的石桌。
石桌上放着一幅卷轴，一个玉盒，以及一把剑。
莫凡打开卷轴，是一部功法，名为不灭金身诀。从功法名字上看，这应该是一部炼体功法。
放下卷轴，莫凡又打开玉盒，里面只有一枚紫色的樱桃大小的灵果。
“紫麟果！”陆飞烟在一旁发出惊叫。
“莫凡，可以把这紫麟果给我吗？”她的语气甚是急切。
莫凡把玉盒合上，然后随手把玉盒递给陆飞烟。
陆飞烟接过玉盒，看着莫凡道：“这可是非常珍贵的紫麟果，都不问一下，就给我了？”
莫凡轻笑一声：“咱俩一起进来，当然是见者有份啊。”
“可是，这紫麟果应该是这里最珍贵的。”
“打住，你可别说它为什么珍贵，万一我知道了就重新考虑了。”莫凡开了个玩笑。
“好吧，这份情我记下了。这紫麟果是我急需的，我来黑风谷就是想碰碰运气看能不能找到它。”陆飞烟不再客气，收好玉盒。
莫凡拿起石桌上的剑，拔剑出鞘，剑身很是古朴，靠近剑柄的地方，刻着“太一”二字。
莫凡现在用的剑，是莫唯风从云霄阁库房找来的，品级不算高，现在还能凑合着用，等他修为上去，这把剑就不够用了。这太一剑能被成为这位前辈的佩剑，肯定是一把好剑。
“这把剑我留着，这功法你要吗？”莫凡问陆飞烟。
“炼体很痛苦，也很艰难，我才不要。”陆飞烟撇嘴。
“好吧，那我就收下这两样了。”莫凡收起卷轴和太一剑。
莫凡朝尸骸鞠了一躬，“前辈，得罪了。”
然后，开始在尸骸的衣袍里翻找起来。没让他失望，在尸骸的手指上，戴着一枚戒指。
“这是须弥戒，也叫空间戒。”见莫凡拿着戒指翻来覆去的看，陆飞烟在一旁解释道。
“里面能存放东西的空间戒？”莫凡大感兴趣。
content_en:
Lu Feiyan emerged from the cane, kicked the man hard several times, then drew his sword and chopped off the head neatly. She was not even interested in interrogating this despicable man who was shooting arrows behind him.
Mo Fanti held the sword in his hand and said to Lu Feiyan: "I'll explore the way in front, you follow me." After that, he walked towards the cave.
Lu Feiyan looked at Mo Fan with soft eyes, and then said: "Okay."
The cave is just big enough for a person to walk. Although it is narrow, it is not dark because the cave walls emit a shining white light.
Mo Fan explored carefully to avoid accidentally touching any mechanism. But the journey is safe, without any traps or traps.
The cave winds all the way down. After walking for a mile, I came to a stone room. The stone room was not big, only two feet square, and there was a stone table in the middle. A figure faced away from the entrance of the cave and sat in front of the stone table.
"Senior, excuse me!" Mo Fan cupped his hands and said softly.
There was no response for a long time, and Lu Feiyan behind him said softly: "Isn't he dead?"
Mo Fan thought it made sense and walked in front of the figure.
Really dead! Under the loose robe, there was only a skeleton. There are also black markings on the bones.
"He died of poisoning. Look at the black spots on the bones." Lu Feiyan said as he came closer.
Mo Fan is still a novice in the world of cultivation and cannot understand this. He looked at the stone table in front of the corpse.
There is a scroll, a jade box, and a sword on the stone table.
Mo Fan opened the scroll, which was a technique called the Immortal Golden Body Technique. Judging from the name of the exercise, this should be a body-training exercise.
Putting down the scroll, Mo Fan opened the jade box again. There was only a purple cherry-sized spiritual fruit inside.
"Purple Linguo!" Lu Feiyan screamed from the side.
"Mo Fan, can you give me this purple lin fruit?" Her tone was very urgent.
Mo Fan closed the jade box and handed it to Lu Feiyan.
Lu Feiyan took the jade box, looked at Mo Fan and said, "This is a very precious purple lin fruit. You gave it to me without even asking?"
Mo Fan chuckled softly: "We come in together, of course we have a chance to meet each other."
"But this purple lin fruit should be the most precious here."
"Stop it, don't tell me why it's precious. If I find out, I'll reconsider it." Mo Fan made a joke.
"Okay, I'll keep this in mind. This purple lin fruit is what I need urgently. I came to Black Wind Valley just to try my luck to see if I can find it." Lu Feiyan stopped being polite and put away the jade box.
Mo Fan picked up the sword on the stone table and unsheathed it. The sword was very simple, with the word "Tai Yi" engraved near the hilt.
The sword Mo Fan is using now was found by Mo Weifeng from the Yunxiao Pavilion warehouse. It is not of a high grade and can be used for now. When his cultivation level increases, this sword will not be enough. If this Taiyi Sword can be used as the sword of this senior, it must be a good sword.
"I'll keep this sword. Do you want this technique?" Mo Fan asked Lu Feiyan.
"Refining the body is painful and difficult. I don't want it." Lu Feiyan curled his lips.
"Okay, then I will accept these two." Mo Fan put away the scroll and Taiyi Sword.
Mo Fan bowed to the corpse, "Senior, I'm offended."
Then, he began to rummage through the corpse's clothes. He was not disappointed, there was a ring on the corpse's finger.
"This is the Sumeru Ring, also called the Space Ring." Seeing Mo Fan flipping the ring over and over, Lu Feiyan explained at the side.
"A space ring that can store things inside?" Mo Fan was very interested.
